title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #15 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a benefit of obeying parents? (1 mark)
   A. Trouble
   B. Lost trust
   C. Peace at home
   D. Poor marks

2. What is a good way of obeying? (1 mark)
   A. Complain
   B. Do it later
   C. Do it at once and cheerfully
   D. Refuse

3. What did Jesus do to the children? (1 mark)
   A. Ignored them
   B. Sent them home
   C. Gave them money
   D. Placed His hands on them and blessed them

4. In which Gospel passage did Jesus bless little children? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. John 3:1
   C. Matthew 19:13-15
   D. Acts 2:1

5. If you break a friend's ruler, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Blame another
   B. Say sorry and offer to replace it
   C. Say nothing
   D. Hide it

6. What should you do with a borrowed book? (1 mark)
   A. Sell it
   B. Keep it
   C. Return it in good condition
   D. Damage it

7. What does the word holy mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rich
   B. Pure and set apart for God
   C. Famous
   D. Old

8. Which is a sin? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Helping
   C. Sharing
   D. Stealing

9. Which is an activity in church? (1 mark)
   A. Selling goods
   B. Playing football inside
   C. Praying and singing
   D. Fighting

10. What does Psalm 122:1 say people were glad to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to sleep
   B. Go to war
   C. Go to market
   D. Go to the house of the Lord

11. Which disciple was a tax collector? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Philip
   C. Matthew
   D. Andrew

12. What did the first Christians devote themselves to? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Travel
   C. Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   D. Trading

13. What does persecution mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being praised
   B. Being taught
   C. Being treated badly because of what you believe
   D. Being paid

14. What did Stephen see before he died? (1 mark)
   A. Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   B. Nothing
   C. A lion
   D. A storm

15. Which of these is a person you can pray for? (1 mark)
   A. No one
   B. Your parents
   C. Only yourself
   D. Only leaders

16. What does "Amen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Let it be so
   B. Goodbye
   C. Hello
   D. Thank you for food

17. What does patience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to wait
   B. Being angry
   C. Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   D. Rushing

18. Who helps believers to show the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. The market
   B. The neighbour
   C. The king
   D. The Holy Spirit

19. What does self-control mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being loud
   B. Doing whatever you want
   C. Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   D. Being lazy

20. What does integrity mean when using a phone? (1 mark)
   A. Wasting data
   B. Copying others
   C. Hiding things
   D. Doing right when nobody is watching

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give two examples of school property. (2 marks)

22. Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways. (4 marks)

23. Give two signs of a person with self-control. (2 marks)

24. Describe what a child should do when they lose or break something belonging to someone else. (3 marks)

25. Describe how Jesus responded when the disciples sent the children away. (3 marks)

26. Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God. (2 marks)

27. Explain why a Christian should behave well online even when nobody is watching. (3 marks)

28. Describe four ways in which children can serve in church. (4 marks)

29. Explain what the Lord's Prayer teaches about forgiveness and protection. (5 marks)

30. Give two meanings of the word church. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Peace at home
   Obedience brings harmony.

2. C — Do it at once and cheerfully
   Obey promptly and willingly.

3. D — Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   Matthew 19:15 says He blessed them.

4. C — Matthew 19:13-15
   Matthew 19:13-15 records it.

5. B — Say sorry and offer to replace it
   Honesty and repair are responsible.

6. C — Return it in good condition
   Borrowed items must be returned.

7. B — Pure and set apart for God
   Holy means pure and set apart.

8. D — Stealing
   Stealing is taking what is not yours.

9. C — Praying and singing
   Worship includes prayer and singing.

10. D — Go to the house of the Lord
   The psalm rejoices at going to God's house.

11. C — Matthew
   Matthew was a tax collector.

12. C — Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   Acts 2:42.

13. C — Being treated badly because of what you believe
   Persecution is unfair treatment for faith.

14. A — Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   Acts 7:55-56.

15. B — Your parents
   We pray for parents, friends and others.

16. A — Let it be so
   Amen means so be it.

17. C — Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   Patience is calm waiting.

18. D — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit grows the fruit.

19. C — Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   Self-control means governing yourself.

20. D — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Desks, textbooks, library books, toilets, compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Waits turn, controls anger, shares, saves money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the owner honestly, say sorry, offer to replace or repair it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: He told them to let the children come, said the kingdom belongs to them, and blessed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: God sees everything; integrity means doing right in private; good behaviour protects us and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing in the choir, help clean, welcome visitors, read a verse, take the offering, help in Sunday school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to forgive us as we forgive others, so we must forgive. We ask Him to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, so we depend on His protection and try to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's forgiveness, 1 for forgiving others, 1 for temptation, 1 for evil, 1 for depending on God.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: The building where Christians worship; the community of believers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
